module.Title: Store Multiple Readings
module.Teaching: A list stores an ordered collection inside square brackets. Lists are ideal for groups of sensor values.
module.PredictionExplanation: Python list literals use square brackets.
module.DebugPrompt: Parentheses create a tuple; use square brackets for this editable list.
module.RecallPrompt: Create the four-value temperatures list. Use these exact values: 18.2, 18.9, 19.1, 20.4.
module.TransferPrompt: Create a pressures list containing 41.2, 42.0, and 41.7.
module.PreviewMessage: The sensor network can now retain multiple readings.
